name: weave_list_tools
description: Lists the authenticated user's Weave tools — published Weave workflows they can run — in their active Weave workspace. Here "tool" means a Weave tool (a published Weave workflow), not an agent/MCP tool. Use this when the user wants to see, browse, or choose from their Weave tools. Returns each tool's name, creation date, and a link to open it in Weave. If the user already pasted a specific Weave URL (app.weavy.ai/tool/<id> or app.weavy.ai/flow/<id>), you already have its recipeId — that `<id>` — so skip this and go straight to weave_get_tool_inputs/weave_run_tool instead of opening a browser.
